sentences.text:
---- Resp
20.01.2023 Mr. P. R. Patankar, counsel for the applicant.
Ms. Meena Shastri, Addl. A. G. for the State/respondent.
Heard on I.A.No.01/2023, Application for Grant of Ad-interim bail.

The applicant has been arrested in connection with Crime No.525/2022 registered in police station Pulgaon, District Durg, CG for offence punishable under Sections 420, 34 of IPC & Section 66 D of I.T. Act.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is only 19 years old lady and she is in advance pregnancy of 9 months, therefore, he prays that her application for interim bail may be considered.
State counsel on verification submits that she is in advance pregnancy of 9 months.

Having heard counsel for the parties and having regard to factual situation of the case, considering the fact that the applicant is in advance pregnancy of 9 months, at this stage, I am inclined to allow the application for grant of interim bail to the applicant.
Accordingly, the application I.A.No.01/2023 is allowed.
Applicant is directed to be released on interim bail in the event of her executing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.10,000/- with one surety to the satisfaction for the concerned trial Court.
List this case for final hearing.

Sd/-
(Sachin Singh Rajput) Judge Parul Kajal Gupta vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161450400/
